title: textured quads from texture atlas
shortDescription: Instanced quads with frames picked by name from a TextureAtlas
description: The instanced quads of *textured quads*, but each one shows a frame of its own. A `TextureStore` loads the atlas `labWallsAtlas` from the texture catalog, `atlas.frameNames(/numbers32/)` selects frames by name, `atlas.frame(name).coords` returns their `TextureCoords`, and each quad gets one of them at random. The atlas image is shown in the preview in the corner.
